item.title: A Pokémon-Inspired RPG More Than 20 Years In The Making Is Finally Heading To The Switch
item.description: Better late than never.If you're a fan of pixel art RPGs with a hint of Pokémon in its gameplay, then you'll want to keep an eye out for Navinosuke – The Yo-kai Buster – on the Switch. Originally developed in the early 2000s but never officially released, it's now been updated with improved UI and gameplay for modern audiences. item.title: Final Fantasy XIV Online Director Reportedly Hints At Nintendo Release
item.description: Is it finally happening?The Final Fantasy XIV Online director Naoki 'Yoshi-P' Yoshida has spoken about bringing the popular MMORPG to Nintendo platforms on multiple occasions.During a New Year chat, he has now been asked once again about the possibility of this title coming to Switch systems and has reportedly told fans to "please look forward to it" (thanks, Livedoor).Read the full article on nintendolife.com
